# sendgrid_google_analytics_settings (Data Source)

Google Analytics tracking adds [UTM parameters](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/ui/account-and-settings/tracking#google-analytics) to the links in your emails, so you can see in Google Analytics which emails brought visitors to your site.

SendGrid stores one Google Analytics setting per account, so this data source always reads that single setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_google_analytics_settings" "example" {}

output "utm_source" {
  value = data.sendgrid_google_analytics_settings.example.utm_source
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if Google Analytics tracking is enabled or disabled.
- `utm_campaign` (String) The value set as `utm_campaign` in the links.
- `utm_content` (String) The value set as `utm_content` in the links.
- `utm_medium` (String) The value set as `utm_medium` in the links.
- `utm_source` (String) The value set as `utm_source` in the links.
- `utm_term` (String) The value set as `utm_term` in the links.
